entities.summary: Balangir also known as Bolangir, is a town and a municipality, the headquarters of Balangir district in the state of Odisha, India. Balangir's cultural heritage makes it one of the finest places for tourists in Odisha. Balangir municipality is divided into 21 wards. It is spread over an area of 12,200 acres (4,900 ha).
